author: d. s. rocha
title: Kate Taylor sets program record as Dolphins split matches in Fort Myers - Duval Times
text:
Jacksonville University beach volleyball split its two matches on March 21 in Fort Myers, sweeping Sam Houston 5-0 before falling to Florida Gulf Coast University (FGCU) 4-1 at The ROC.
The day was highlighted by Kate Taylor’s achievement at the No. 4 flight. With a straight-set win alongside Morgan Perry, Taylor recorded her 16th career victory at the four position, surpassing Kristina Nika for the most wins in that spot in program history. Taylor began the season with eight wins at No. 4 and now holds the record alone.
In their opening match, Jacksonville dominated Sam Houston across all five courts. Claire Mrukowski and Megan Hair secured a straight-set win at No. 1, while Breanna McDonough and Meredith Mrukowski won a three-set battle at No. 2. Avery Kleithermes and Jamie Seward claimed victory at No. 3, followed by Perry and Taylor clinching the dual at No. 4. Maddie Fielder and Katie Martinez completed the sweep with a win at No. 5.
In the afternoon session against FGCU, Jacksonville managed one point as Perry and Taylor again won in straight sets at No. 4. FGCU took victories on the other four courts to secure a team win.
Jacksonville will return home next weekend to host the River City Invitational, which also marks Senior Weekend for the team. Seniors Alizé Lemieux, Jamie Seward, Morgan Perry, Lizzie Kitchen, Katie Martinez, and Breanna McDonough will be honored as play begins Friday against Wingate and Lake Sumter State before facing Florida Southern and Palm Beach Atlantic on Saturday.
